title: Mind Garden machine-local scope configuration
description: An explicitly confirmed, machine-local authorization for one Obsidian Vault subdirectory. Runtime configuration is stored outside the Skill installation directory.

vault_path.description: Absolute user-confirmed Vault root. Runtime realpath/no-follow validation is authoritative.

allowed_subdirectory.description: One non-root, POSIX-style Vault-relative scope; it cannot be empty, ., .., absolute, drive, UNC, or contain a backslash.

x-mind-garden-runtime-validation: Configuration absence produces only a bootstrap prompt or unsaved draft; it never selects, scans, or reads a default Vault.
The Python scope guard canonicalizes Vault and scope with realpath, requires the scope to be a strict Vault descendant, and revalidates each operation.
Every target is a scope-relative path and all existing components use descriptor-relative lstat/fstat plus O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY where supported. Unsupported trusted semantics fail closed.
Scope-external, symlinked, special, absolute, drive, UNC, ., and .. paths are rejected without exposing the external path or content.
